# OptimisedWebsite

> OptimisedWebsite is a UK web studio that builds SEO-optimised websites: sites engineered from first principles for organic search visibility, where keyword research and topical mapping precede the build and pages ship with relevant JSON-LD schema and performance testing.

## Summary
OptimisedWebsite (https://optimisedwebsite.com) designs and builds SEO-optimised Astro websites for UK businesses. Builds range from single-location sites of up to 25 pages to multi-location builds and migrations of several hundred pages, structured around hub-and-spoke content architecture, with entity-interconnected JSON-LD schema and static-first output. Priced in three levels by scope: Local site 1,500 to 3,000 GBP, Growth site 3,000 to 6,000 GBP, Multi-location and migration 6,000 to 15,000 GBP. The price is fixed in a written build plan before work starts. Timescales run from 1 to 2 weeks for a local site to 6 to 12 weeks for a multi-location or full migration project. Founded and run by Sunny Patel, an SEO consultant based in Reading, UK.

## Canonical definitions
- SEO-optimised website: A website engineered from first principles for organic search visibility. Keyword research, topical mapping, internal-linking architecture, and schema planning happen before HTML is written. Pages use relevant JSON-LD schema within a site-wide @graph, and static-first output supports strong Core Web Vitals. This is distinct from a conventional website that retrofits SEO after design is complete. Related concepts: Search engine optimization (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Search_engine_optimization), Web design (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_design).
- Topical authority: The depth and breadth of content a site has on a subject. OptimisedWebsite builds it in from day one via hub-and-spoke linking rather than retrofitting it.
- Hub-and-spoke architecture: A content pattern where a central hub page links to related spoke pages, consolidating topical authority and distributing internal link equity.

## Key facts and stats
- Founder: Sunny Patel, SEO Consultant, Reading, UK
- Proof: five owned sites, Google Search Console, 28 days to 25 September 2026: 5,168 clicks and 254.1k impressions across 568 pages (https://optimisedwebsite.com/state-of-seo-websites/). These are Sunny Patel's own sites, not client results
- Performance: tested before handover, with Core Web Vitals considered throughout the build
- Delivery time: 1 to 2 weeks (Local site), 3 to 5 weeks (Growth site), 6 to 12 weeks (Multi-location and migration)
- Price: 1,500 to 15,000 GBP across three levels, fixed before work starts (no recurring platform fee from OptimisedWebsite)
- Tech stack: Astro, Tailwind CSS, deployed to Cloudflare Pages edge network
- Schema types per site: 7 to 12 (Organization, WebSite, Service, Article, FAQPage, HowTo, BreadcrumbList and more)
- Page count per build: up to 25 (Level 1), 25 to 100 (Level 2), 100 to several hundred (Level 3)
- Ownership: client owns the GitHub repository, domain, hosting account, and content; no proprietary CMS, no vendor lock-in

## Services
- SEO Website Build: Complete Astro site with hub-and-spoke architecture
- Keyword Research: Niche analysis, keyword clustering, topical mapping
- Schema Markup: Entity-interconnected JSON-LD (7 to 12 types per site)
- Technical SEO: Sitemap, robots.txt, canonicals, Core Web Vitals
- Content Architecture: Internal linking strategy, heading hierarchy
